text:
Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor - Official Launch Trailer
Leave it to luck? Not a chance. Check out the Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor launch trailer for another look at this expansion for the action-adventure game. Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor brings two story chapters set in 1905 Sicily starring Enzo Favara alongside Ennio Salieri, new Free Ride mode challenges, jobs, weapons, outfits, vehicles, and horses. Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor expansion is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC. 

Sicily – Winter, 1905. In the months since his initiation, Enzo Favara has proven himself a reliable soldier of the Torrisi crime family. Now the Don entrusts him and Cesare with a delicate assignment: assist Ennio Salieri, a man of honor recently released from prison and intent on reclaiming what is his.

At Salieri's side, Enzo is drawn deeper into the volatile underworld of the Valle Dorata, where loyalty is tested, debts are settled, and every move carries weight.

Additionally, the Mafia: The Omertà Collection is out now. Mafia: The Omertà Collection features Mafia: The Old Country Definitive Edition (including the Man of Honor expansion and Deluxe content), Mafia: Definitive Edition (including the PS5 version with 60 FPS gameplay and technical improvements), Mafia II: Definitive Edition (including all DLC, and Mafia III: Definitive Edition (including all DLC).

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, PC (BattleNet, Steam, Xbox on PC), and Xbox Series X/S on October 23, 2026. author: IGN YouTube
text:
Lanterns Series Premiere Review
James Gunn's DCU returns to the small screen with Lanterns on HBO and HBO Max. Starring Kyle Chandler as Hal Jordan and Aaron Pierre as John Stewart, the series premiere kicks off in a decidedly less cosmic corner of the Green Lantern mythos. After the reaction to Supergirl and a few cancelled tv shows, there's a lot riding on the success of Lanterns, but is a dusty small town murder mystery investigated by space cops the answer to get the DCU back on track? IGN's Jesse Schedeen reviews the premiere to talk about Damon Lindelof, Hal Jordan's grumpiness and why the casting turned out to be perfect.

text:
Control Resonant: Exclusive Boss Fight Gameplay - IGN First
Resonants are the biggest threats that Control Resonant has to offer. The big bosses at the centre of the game’s corrupted New York play a massive role in Remedy’s latest story, as well as the world around them. We’ll get into that, and much more about how killing them might make your life harder in our next IGN First drop. For more on the game, you can check out the exclusive Metro Fault mission gameplay we revealed last week, as well as a deep dive into Control Resonant’s combat system and the philosophy behind it.

For now, it’s time to watch Dylan in action as he takes on the Central Resonant, a giant, fiery monster that loves to turn the floor into lava and spurt bursts of magma in your direction, as well as a little bit of run-up to the location of the mission itself. Enjoy!
